name: A2
description: The Audi A2 (1999–2005) was a revolutionary aluminium space-frame subcompact — the first volume-production aluminium car — predating Audi's ASF strategy by a decade. Its Lite construction saved 40% weight versus steel equivalent. Discontinued due to high production costs despite critical acclaim.
